spells.name: Summon Burning Head
spells.effect: Set up a **The Burning Head** endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
spells.declare: If there is not a friendly **The Burning Head** endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
